run_inference_attribute: run the attribute function to predict date and geographical region from historical text
run_inference_restore: run the restore function to predict missing characters in historical text using beam search
build_attribution_results_json: build an AttributionResults object and serialize it to JSON with location and date predictions
build_restoration_results_json: build a RestorationResults object and serialize it to JSON with top predictions and saliency maps
test_prepare_text: test the _prepare_text function to validate text padding, accent stripping, and character index conversion
